Vol. 2 No. 37 (2025): Journal of the College of Education for Girls for Humanities

A semi-annual peer-reviewed scientific journal, with two issues per year, dealing with humanistic studies. It was established in 2007 at the College of Education for Girls, University of Kufa, and specializes in publishing humanitarian research characterized by originality and creativity presented by researchers from universities around the world, after presenting it to scientific evaluators. It is accredited by the Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research and all Iraqi universities for the purposes of scientific promotion, and all its issues are available on the website of the Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research for peer-reviewed Iraqi academic journals.

The journal seeks to publish research and studies that are distinguished by their scientific value and academic sobriety,  in the fields of Qur’anic and jurisprudential studies, linguistic and literary studies, legal, political and economic studies, historical and geographical studies, and psychological and educational sciences.
